cf auth login

Authenticate with Cloudflare

Global flags
  -q, --quiet       Suppress non-essential output     [boolean] [default: false]
  -z, --zone        Zone ID or domain name (overrides CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID)
                                                                        [string]
      --profile     Use a specific auth profile                         [string]
  -m, --mode        Mode used to evaluate project configuration         [string]
      --local       Use local resource simulations    [boolean] [default: false]
      --persist-to  Directory holding local persisted state (default:
                    .cloudflare/state next to cloudflare.config.ts)     [string]
  -h, --help        Show help                                          [boolean]
  -v, --version     Show version number                                [boolean]

Options
      --dry-run      Parse arguments and show the command without executing it
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
  -f, --force        Force re-authentication even if already logged in
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
      --browser      Open the authorization link in a browser (use --no-browser
                     to print it instead)              [boolean] [default: true]
      --device       Use OAuth device authorization (use --no-device for the
                     localhost callback flow)          [boolean] [default: true]
      --scopes       The set of OAuth scopes to request                  [array]
      --use-keyring  Encrypt OAuth credentials using the OS keychain (persisted
                     across invocations; use --no-use-keyring to disable)
                                                                       [boolean]
